description: Mirror/origin attestation that a server is serving a content-addressed video via /watch (ADR 0036). Authored by the broadcaster DID, not the video author.

main.description: Origin attestation. Heartbeats update lastSeenAt; retract the record to leave the origin set.

subject.description: Strong ref to the tools.garazyk.video record being served.

server.description: DID of the mirror or PDS origin publishing this attestation.

watchBaseUrl.description: HTTPS base for /watch/{did}/{manifestCid}/… relative to this origin.

manifestCid.description: SHA-256 CID of the DRISL/MASL manifest blob named by the subject.

lastSeenAt.description: Last successful heartbeat from this origin.

irohTicket.description: Optional legacy iroh ticket field (ADR 0038). Used on broadcast.origin for NodeTicket semantics. For Garazyk CA/VOD origins prefer irohEndpointId.

httpsBase.description: Optional explicit HTTPS provider base when distinct from watchBaseUrl (ADR 0038).

irohEndpointId.description: Stable iroh EndpointID for the jelcz-iroh-blobs-sidecar (Track A, ADR 0038). Prefer this over irohTicket for Garazyk CA/VOD origins.

irohEndpointTicket.description: Optional bootstrap EndpointTicket for the Track A iroh-blobs sidecar. Absent when not advertising a ticket.

view.description: AppView hydration of an origin attestation.

author.description: Broadcaster DID that authored the origin record.

playlist.description: Resolved master playlist URL when known.
